summary: Hand-built grammar-state char LM (phase/agreement-stack/clause registers + prefix-conditioned lookup) reaches dev bpc 0.6827, top1 0.8053 from uniform bootstrap.
Enforcing at most one modifier per NP with type-specific modifier rates improved bpc 0.6939 -> 0.6913 versus free modifier attachment.
Weighting 'the' ~2x other determiners (plus vi/adj rate updates) gave 0.6913 -> 0.6880; lowering word/char smoothing and raising RS prep rate gave 0.6842.
EOS after '.' modeled as logistic ramp in step centered 147.5: after_period bpc 0.077 -> 0.043; sharper slope 1.0 gave no further total gain.
Model is near the entropy floor of its own grammar (sampled self-entropy ~0.68 bpc); remaining gains likely need non-uniform lemma weights rather than structure.
Nesting-depth decay of modifier probability (x0.6 per extra RC level) did not help (0.6828 vs 0.6827).
